            Health Tips

            Health Tips — Small habits, big shifts.

            💧
            Hydrate first
            A glass of water before each meal supports digestion and appetite control.
            🍎
            Half-plate rule
            Fill half your plate with vegetables, a quarter protein, a quarter whole grains.
            🏃
            Move every hour
            Stand up and stretch for 2 minutes each hour — your metabolism thanks you.
            🧠
            Sleep & stress
            7–9 hours of quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and recovery.

            Download the Android APK and install it directly, or add the web app to your home screen on iPhone and Android. Same features, faster access.

            ⬇ Download APK iPhone install

            The Android APK isn't bundled in this exported file — use "Add to Home Screen" below in the meantime.

            📱 Android (APK)

            1. Tap Download APK above.
            2. Open the downloaded file.
            3. Allow "Install from unknown sources" if prompted.
            4. Tap Install — done.

            🍎 iPhone / iPad

            1. Open this site in Safari.
            2. Tap the Share icon.
            3. Choose Add to Home Screen.
            4. Launch it like a native app.

            📱 Android (Browser)

            1. Open this site in Chrome.
            2. Tap the ⋮ menu.
            3. Tap Install app / Add to Home screen.
            4. App icon appears on your home screen.
            Your Data, Your Control

            My Data & Privacy

            Everything you log — food, activity, weight, profile — stays only in this browser's storage. Export it anytime, or clear it completely.

            🛡️

            VitalBrief is educational and not medical advice — it does not diagnose, treat or cure any condition. Nothing you log here is sent to a server; it lives in your browser's local storage until you export or delete it.
